text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

WHEAT SALE - The Taiwan Flour Mills Association bought 61,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat in two shipments at a tender on Tuesday. Freight for the first shipment was fixed at US$22.15 per tonne and the second at US$20.50 a tonne, traders said.

BARLEY SALE - The Cyprus Grain Commission on Tuesday accepted the tender of Finagrain Geneve for the supply of 25,000 tonnes of barley at $155.95 per tonne, it said. The price includes cost and freight. Shipment of the barley is scheduled for May or June.

RICE SALE - Costa Rican millers late Friday in a private negotiation bought 26,500 tonnes Argentine or U.S. long grain rough rice at sellers' option for June 30-July 7 shipment, several U.S. exporters said. The rice was bought at $296 a tonne, CIF, landed (sellers pay for discharge) and a 90-day bill of lading, one U.S. exporter said.
WHEAT TENDER - Grain traders confirmed on Tuesday they had received a May 14 tender from Tunisia for 125,000 tonnes of soft wheat to be shipped in July, August and September.
WHEAT TENDERS - Taiwan will seek 52,000 tonnes U.S. wheat on May 14, several U.S. exporters said.

WHEAT TENDER - Sri Lanka seeks 100,000 tonnes HRW wheat in two lots of 50,000 tonnes. Tenders close on May 16. The first shipment was for May 22-June 5 if from U.S., Canada, Europe or Argentina, and June 10-19 from Australia or Saudi Arabia. The second lot was for June 16-25 if from U.S., Canada, Continent or Argentina, and June 30-July 9 from Australia or Saudi Arabia.
FLOUR TENDER - Yemen seeks 150,000 tonnes of soft wheat flour on May 13 for August/October shipment. The flour was expected to come from the EU, U.S. or both.

DURUM TENDER - Algeria launched a same-day import tender for 100,000 tonnes of durum wheat for shipment in June and July. The tender is for four equal shipments of optional origin,with two cargoes to be shipped during the second half of June and the rest in the first half of July, they said.
SOY AND CORN TENDER - Taiwan may tender up to 92,000 tonnes of soybeans and 16,000 tonnes of corn this week.
SOYBEAN TENDER - South Korea's state-run Agricultural and Fishery Marketing Corp has invited offers for 40,000 tonnes of No.1 soybeans. Bidding will close on May 15.

SOYBEAN TENDERS - Japanese buyers will be picking up U.S. soybeans for July shipment this week due to firmer quotes seen on U.S. Gulf/Japan freight rates, traders said. "End-users returned to the market since last week and are watching the freight cost across the Pacific Ocean," a soybean trader at a major trade house in Japan said.

SOYMEAL TENDER - El Salvador was retendering for about 8,000 to 10,000 tonnes of U.S. soybean meal under the PL-480 export program for June 1-15, July 1-31 and/or August 1-31 delivery. Offers were to be submitted no later than May 12 and will be valid until May 13.

LENTIL TENDER - Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade offered 16,000 tonnes of lentils for export. An international call for prices set May 20 as the final date to receive bids and confirmation made on May 21.
SUNOIL TENDER - The CCC seeks 2,000 tonnes refined U.S. sunflower seed oil for donation under its export program to Bosnia. Offers were due on May 13.
RICE TENDER - Jordan seeks 15,000 tonnes of medium grain camolina type rice on May 21 for June delivery
